problem: HTML edition selection rejected the valid native compression guard in the shared preamble.
scope: Only canonical src/common/preamble.tex may contain this content-free conditional: a literal pdfcompresslevel assignment from 0 through 9. All other conditional flags retain their existing policy.
source_boundary: Raw preamble and selected-source hashes remain recorded. Document-level macro shadowing, unknown conditional rights definitions, prose, else branches, nesting, dynamic values and imports refuse.
limit: Complete browser-product recording and site verification are separate integration gates.
